steps.title: Initialize Project Structure
steps.description: Generate base configuration files including build scripts, metadata files, and steps directory structures for compilation.

steps.title: Configure App Build Properties
steps.description: Write app/build.gradle with Android Gradle Plugin rules, target compile SDK 34, and dependencies.

steps.title: Configure Manifest and Launch Properties
steps.description: Establish application parameters and reference correct launchers and icon parameters inside AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Set App Colors and Typography
steps.description: Define standard colors including rich charcoal dark modes, electric accent oranges, blues, and pure blacks to maximize screen contrast.

steps.title: Define Application Styles
steps.description: Create style entries with Material values and clean full-screen properties.

steps.title: Create Numeric Key Resources
steps.description: Draft btn_numeric.xml state selectors for standard numeric buttons with dark grey circular shapes.

steps.title: Create Operator Key Resources
steps.description: Draft btn_operator.xml state selectors to map glowing action indicators for plus, minus, multiply, and division signs.

steps.title: Create Scientific Key Resources
steps.description: Generate btn_scientific.xml selector background maps for trigonometric, log, and constant variables.

steps.title: Create Main Action Key Resources
steps.description: Generate btn_action.xml selector states for clear/backspace tasks with customized responsive visual states.

steps.title: Create Accent Equals Key Resources
steps.description: Draft btn_equals.xml with glowing electric blue rounded contours indicating output evaluation.

steps.title: Design Calculator Layout Grid
steps.description: Construct activity_main.xml file with scrollable inputs, double text display, and standard keyboard row grid mapped with precise proportional weights.

steps.title: Configure App String Resources
steps.description: Create static application texts and titles in standard strings.xml structure.

steps.title: Implement Expression Parsing Core
steps.description: Build recursive mathematical parser structure in MainActivity.java allowing basic operators, powers, roots, trigonometry and constants processing.

steps.title: Wire Up Dynamic Input and Button Receivers
steps.description: Establish click event distributions, handle multi-character deletions (e.g. sin( to clear), backspace safety layers, and parenthesis auto-closures inside MainActivity.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Complete final verification checks, assemble resources and finalize building of debug package.
